answer: Reaching eligibility takes 37 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary burns for every seat it wants. The haven register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and onyx seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 37 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
